mapper.select: SELECT p.*, pi.image_id, IFNULL(pi.origin_name, 'default.jpg') AS origin_name, -- NULL이면 기본값 설정 IFNULL(pi.file_path, '/upload/default.jpg') AS file_path -- NULL이면 기본 경로 설정 FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id WHERE p.product_id = #{product_id}
SELECT p.*, pi.image_id, pi.origin_name, pi.file_path FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id ORDER BY p.product_id DESC
SELECT MAX(product_id)+1 as product_id FROM products
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (product_id, name, category, price, stock, regdate) values (#{product_id}, #{name}, #{category}, #{price}, #{stock}, now() )
